sentences.text: If you shine a light beam through a dark box, you have a smoke detector.
But when smoke drifts up from a burning trash can, the beam just keeps shining.
So you add a sensor off to the side, and smoke bounces light onto it.
But a sensor makes no sound, and at night everyone sleeps through the fire.
So you add a horn that blares at least 85 decibels at 10 feet.
This is a photoelectric smoke detector.
Fire safety experts say to replace it every 10 years.
Add a battery, a test button and vents.
Congratulations, you have built a smoke detector.
